description: Find a library in Context7 by name and get its ids, so you can pull its current documentation. Works without a key.

api_key.description: Optional Context7 API key for higher rate limits (or set CONTEXT7_API_KEY)

library_name.description: Library name, e.g. next.js, react-query, supabase

query.description: What you want to do with it, to rank the matches

name: context7_find_library
